driverFormulas.rev: Total Operating Income = Interest, Commission & Insurance Income − Interest & Commission Expense
driverFormulas.cogs: Impairment of Credits (IFRS 9 ECL) = Stage 1/2 Movement + Stage 3 Impairments + Overlays
driverFormulas.gp: Income after Credit Losses = Operating Income − Impairment of Credits
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Income after Credit Losses % = GP / Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Operating Expenses (excl. depreciation) = Distribution & Advisory + IT & Data + Group Functions
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: Pre-Depreciation Margin % = Pre-Depreciation Profit / Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation & Amortisation = Equipment + Leases + IT Systems
driverFormulas.ebit: Comparable Operating Profit = Pre-Depreciation Profit − D&A
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Items Affecting Comparability & Other = Associates + AT1 Interest + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Profit before Tax = Operating Profit + Other Items
driverFormulas.ni: Profit for the Period = PBT − Tax
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Profit Margin % = Profit / Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Lending & Liquidity Assets + Other Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Lending & Liquidity Assets = Cash + Loans + Liquid Assets + Other
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Liquidity Portfolio & Insurance Investments = Bank Liquidity Portfolio + Life Insurance Investments + Loans to Credit Institutions
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Fixed, Intangible & Other Assets = Equipment + Accum. Depreciation + Intangibles + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Deposits & Funding + Other Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Deposits, Covered Bonds & Insurance Liabilities = Deposits & Debt + Accruals + Derivatives + Other
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Subordinated Debt & Other Liabilities = Tier 2 + Tax + Provisions
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Total Equity = Share Capital, Reserves & AT1 + Retained Earnings + Fair Value Reserve
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit + D&A + Balance Sheet Movements
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = IT Investment + Disposals + Other
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Subordinated Debt + AT1 + Dividends
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
